title: pillow cases
text: pillow cases. I am SOOOOO angry.  These are just zippered pillow cases.  NO filling. And of course they are weird sizes so you cannot purchase pillow forms that would look nice.  The fact that these are JUST pillow CASES - NOT pillow needs to be in the description line - straight up!  I did NOT want to have to buy chunky lumpy filling as well.  I am angry enough that I will just be tossing these in the garbage.  I wanted nice, fitted pillows.  You have to BUY chunked up filling - balls or as they suggest "old clothes!"  OMG.  Good luck trying to un-stuff them to clean the cases.  What mess.  I do NOT recommend these and buyer beware.  Read the fine print that SHOULD be in the ad-line.
